ActualMarketValuePostValuationFactor.name: Actual Market Value Post Valuation Factor
ActualMarketValuePostValuationFactor.definition: Actual market value post valuation factor expressed in the collateral currency (denomination currency of the security). For cash, it is the value post haircut.

ActualMarketValueBeforeValuationFactor.name: Actual Market Value Before Valuation Factor
ActualMarketValueBeforeValuationFactor.definition: Actual market value before valuation factor expressed in the collateral currency (denomination currency of the security). For cash, it is the value before haircut.

ExposureCollateralInTransactionCurrency.name: Exposure Collateral In Transaction Currency
ExposureCollateralInTransactionCurrency.definition: Amount of the exposure/collateral in the exposure/collateral currency.

ExposureCollateralInReportingCurrency.name: Exposure Collateral In Reporting Currency
ExposureCollateralInReportingCurrency.definition: Amount of the exposure/collateral in the reporting currency.

MarketValueAmountPostValuationFactor.name: Market Value Amount Post Valuation Factor
MarketValueAmountPostValuationFactor.definition: Market  value post valuation factor expressed in the transaction currency. For cash, it is the value post haircut.

MarketValueAmountBeforeValuationFactor.name: Market Value Amount Before Valuation Factor
MarketValueAmountBeforeValuationFactor.definition: Market value before valuation factor expressed in the transaction currency. For cash, it is the value before haircut.

TotalValueOfOwnCollateral.name: Total Value Of Own Collateral
TotalValueOfOwnCollateral.definition: Total value of own collateral in the reporting currency.

TotalValueOfReusedCollateral.name: Total Value Of Reused Collateral
TotalValueOfReusedCollateral.definition: Total value of reused/rehypotheticated collateral in the reporting currency.
